content.text: A single locked-off first-person shot of Gou An resting on his rope bed, exactly matching the supplied first frame: same face, clothes, pose, lighting and location. Only this one man remains in the frame throughout. His arms stay resting in their starting position. He looks toward the camera and speaks Mandarin naturally, once: “你说得容易。我现在不能把命押在这个办法上。” Then his lips close. Keep the original composition for the entire shot, with subtle breathing and small eye movements. No other person enters, no new objects enter, no cuts, no camera movement, no subtitles, no music. Soft tent ambience only apart from the specified dialogue.
